boundary: This matrix maps security requirements to source frameworks, repository controls, verification commands, manual review, risk records, and release-blocker status.
It validates traceability completeness; it does not prove hosted GitHub settings, manual QA, source truth, or release readiness by itself.
Open and external-blocked requirements remain visible even when the traceability audit passes structurally.

updateTriggers: Security requirements, threat model, risk register, incident response, recovery, release, dependency, workflow, parser, Docker, NLP, source-governance, or generated-artifact controls change.
A risk-register record is opened, mitigated, accepted, or superseded.
A new security gate, manual QA requirement, or hosted setting becomes part of release posture.

requirements.title: Hosted main branch protections are enforced
requirements.requirement: The hosted main branch must enforce the tracked protected-branch policy, required checks, single-maintainer pull-request posture, no force pushes, and no bypass posture before release trust depends on main.
manualReview: Enable and inspect the live GitHub branch protection or ruleset settings with owner/admin access.
Rerun the hosted settings audit with an authenticated token and record the result in the checklist.

requirements.title: Confidential vulnerability intake is available
requirements.requirement: The repository must provide a confidential vulnerability intake path and document fallback handling when private vulnerability reporting is unavailable.
manualReview: Enable GitHub private vulnerability reporting or record an approved private intake alternative.
Confirm public issues do not request exploit details.

requirements.title: Local services are local by default
requirements.requirement: The Express server and VOICEVOX runtime must default to localhost/trusted local use and document any broad binding as deliberate and temporary.
manualReview: When SERVER_HOST is set outside localhost, verify the network is trusted and the workflow is temporary.
When Docker runtime changes, inspect VOICEVOX status and doctor output.

requirements.title: External text is escaped before Anki HTML rendering
requirements.requirement: Text from external or semi-trusted sources must be escaped before entering HTML-rendered Anki fields, while exporter-owned ruby, pitch, audio, and stroke-order markup stays controlled.
manualReview: Manual Anki import QA remains required before release-ready claims.

requirements.title: Supply-chain inputs are pinned, audited, and minimally privileged
requirements.requirement: Dependencies must be lockfile-backed registry packages with integrity hashes, reviewed lifecycle scripts, pinned GitHub Actions, minimal workflow permissions, advisory checks, dependency review, and deterministic SBOM generation.
manualReview: Review any new lifecycle-script package with a specific reason before accepting it.
Review dependency license posture when P3 license automation flags a change.

requirements.title: Hosted security alert settings are visible and triaged
requirements.requirement: Secret scanning, push protection, Dependency Graph, Dependabot security updates, CodeQL alerts, and Dependabot alerts must be enabled, visible, or explicitly triaged from owner-authenticated hosted evidence.
manualReview: Run the hosted settings audit with owner-authenticated security/settings access.
Reopen SEC-P0-005 and triage any open CodeQL, secret scanning, or dependency alert before release claims.

requirements.title: Release artifacts are checksummed, SBOM-backed, attested, and verified before trust
requirements.requirement: Release bundles must include deterministic artifacts, checksums, CycloneDX SBOM, provenance/SBOM attestations, and recorded attestation verification before external trust claims.
manualReview: Verify downloaded release artifacts against release-artifacts.sha256.
Run or record gh attestation verify for each trusted release artifact.
Rerun owner-authenticated security:github-settings:auth after a successful hosted release workflow run proves configured attestation verification.

requirements.title: Source evidence and source-use boundaries are governed
requirements.requirement: External source use must preserve permitted storage boundaries, source-input integrity pins, voting/non-voting lane separation, source-access gaps, and dry-run-first import behavior.
manualReview: Do not promote manual-citation-only or source-access-gap rows without exact permitted assignment evidence.

requirements.title: Card certification authority boundaries stay separated
requirements.requirement: Gold, Sapphire, Platinum, Obsidian, source-governance, NLP support, generated artifacts, media QA, and release readiness must remain separate authority lanes.
manualReview: Do not record Obsidian proof until current-standard actual card-data rereview is complete for the live card.
Complete a release QA evidence packet before claiming APKG, mobile, accessibility, listening, or media QA readiness.

A labeled automation-reviewed prerelease may record unavailable human/device checks only as accepted-risk under PROD-REL-001; production/GA requires passed evidence and must not inherit that exception.

requirements.title: NLP output remains assistive-only
requirements.requirement: Model, tokenizer, embedding, review-packet, and draft-proposal outputs may support review but must not certify cards, source truth, or release readiness.
manualReview: Reviewers must treat NLP signals as attention context only and perform the underlying card/source review separately.

requirements.title: Incidents and recovery have runbooks
requirements.requirement: Security incidents, vulnerability remediation, bad release recovery, bad artifact recovery, dependency recovery, and local runtime recovery must have executable runbooks.
manualReview: Run tabletop or real-incident review before calling response performance proven.

requirements.title: Hostile-input regression coverage is explicit
requirements.requirement: Parser, import, generated HTML, media path, package boundary, Docker-helper argument, and dependency-policy abuse cases should have dedicated hostile-input or fuzz-style regression tests.

requirements.title: Security reviewer training and SDLC metrics are tracked
requirements.requirement: Security reviewer readiness, training expectations, and SDLC health metrics must be documented and validated so security posture can be reviewed over time.
manualReview: Review training completion and SDLC metrics before release governance claims rely on them.

requirements.title: Dependency license compliance is automated
requirements.requirement: Dependency license expressions in package-lock.json must be allowlisted or covered by a current reviewed exception; missing, denied, unreviewed, or overdue exception licenses fail closed, and tagged release bundles must include a generated dependency-license summary.
manualReview: Review any new license expression, denied-pattern match, missing package-license metadata, or non-permissive dependency exception before accepting the lockfile.
Review NOTICE and attribution obligations before external release claims rely on the dependency-license summary.
